goals.goal: One screen on Monday showing forty projects, a color and a number, and believing it
goals.quote: I open one screen on Monday morning and I see forty projects, with a color and a number, and I believe it.

goals.goal: Cumberland's program up on a screen, current, in front of their VP of facilities
goals.quote: If I can pull their program up on a screen in front of their VP of facilities and it's current, that's the win.

goals.goal: Somebody able to answer Warren about staffing without the resource manager
goals.quote: And I'd like somebody to be able to answer Warren without me.
